caption: Spiaggia dei Conigli, Lampedusa
composition: Crescent cove between rocky headlands · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the rocky headland the view opens over a pale crescent of sand curving between limestone cliffs on the right and a low rocky islet standing off to the left. A bright moon hangs in the upper left, laying a silver path across the calm sea, while the eastern horizon blushes faint pink with the coming dawn. At 06:21 the beach is empty and the water is glass-still.
